facts.text: David, you are staying with me tonight. Get some rest, and we'll sort the rest out in the morning.
facts.why: Not an Alex line. The only Alex line on the quote page is 'David, please be rational. Let's go and see Dr. Hirsch.' She does take David in after the hospital, but these words are not hers. Printed in quote marks and signed Alex Price.

vibe.verdict: Good pub, good grub and dry English humour, but the film's best jokes and scares are missing.
